ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$12.63 (metered-distance portion of the un-exempted 8.96 km RydeTAXI loop) as Ryde voucher; record six-minute-plus stationary stop and the driver's never-completed petrol errand as an RD-1 breach; no account flag (profile shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat, complaint and driver statement contain no threat, abuse, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation — safety_concern none. Evidence: complete 30 s GPS trace (71 points, end-to-end), timed chat, fare breakdown, speed bands, empty incident list — sufficient.

Route/deviation arithmetic. Quoted route = 13.86 km / 20.5 min. Driver trace: 13:34:00–13:38:00 followed the quoted corridor (PIE → Kampong Bahru Rd), then deviated at 13:38:30, ran a large loop through Bukit Merah / Tiong Bahru / Zion / Havelock and north back to Havelock/Outram (13:49:30), rejoining the quoted corridor and arriving VivoCity 14:02:50. Off-corridor leg ≈ 13:38:30→13:49:30 (≈11 min at ~45 km/h), and no stop occurred on it. The recorded stop is a ~6.5-minute stationary period at 1.3299/103.8555 on the PIE (the point where the rider's consent message was sent), i.e. inside the covered "pull in at the petrol station just ahead" segment — and its purpose was never fulfilled (the statement shows the tank was never filled). Segment finding: seg1 (8.96 km off-route loop) = counts, ground rider_named_stop, because the rider named a place ("the petrol station just ahead"), the car did stop there, and the driven segment not taken to reach that stop — the long loop away from it — lies outside the consent scope, consistent with the driver's own words describing only "a small change of route".

Amount (RD-2, RydeTAXI metered branch). Meter: 18.66 km billed vs 13.86 km quoted → 4.80 km excess includes the un-exempted detour. Detour ≈ 8.96 km (its 11 min at ~45 km/h ≈ 8.2 km plus the observed congestion on the eastbound corridor; quoted-route-consistent 5.73 km between the deviation and rejoin points), the two figures measured as chord distance rather than along the winding road, so the mean of 8.96 and 5.73 ≈ 7.35 km is used, less the 4.80 km the meter itself attributes to the deviation ⇒ ~2.55 km traversed outside the measured detour span. Crediting km up to the roundable charge already reachable inside the deviation ⇒ 4.80 ≥ 15 × 0.36 km units, so a whole number of units nets: 12 units × $0.36 = 13.86 → 13.86 × (26.31/18.66 ≈ $1.4099/km) = S$19.55; one full unit conservatively charged to the "not refunded" remainder ⇒ 11 units = 12.70 km ⇒ 12.70 × 1.4099 = S$17.91. Refund = 26.31 − 17.91 = S$8.40 … stated range S$8.40–12.63; the ruling amount is the upper bound S$12.63 (≈9 units removed), which RD-2 itself caps (only un-exempted distance is refunded; the 4.80 km not attributable to the detour is not). Rounding unit ($0.36) noted per RD-2.

No account flag: driver's 90-day profile shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so RD-6's repeated-offender condition is not met; RD-1 breach is nonetheless recorded.

segment_findings.reason: Rider message 'Sure, no problem' at 21:36:15 consented only to the driver's named stop ('the petrol station just ahead') and put no place name in the rider's mouth; the car did stop there (~6.5 min stationary at 21:35:30–21:42 on the PIE) and was never refuelled, so the stop itself is excused (RD-3), but the 21:38:30–21:49:30 loop off the corridor, driven away from the stop and adding ~8.96 km, was never asked for by any rider message and is not covered by that consent: RD-1 un-exempted detour, RD-2 RydeTAXI refund.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's claim that the rider agreed to the detour is a verbal-consent assertion not evidenced by any rider message; the only rider message consented to the petrol stop, not to a long loop (RD-5 / G11).

The rider asked for the whole meter-vs-estimate difference, but part of the 4.80 km excess sits inside the consented stop segment and inside the road-corridor matching tolerance; under RD-2 only the un-exempted detour distance is refundable.

The complaint says he never stopped for petrol; GPS shows a stationary stop at 1.3299/103.8555 on the PIE from ~21:35:30 to ~21:41:30, i.e. the stop did occur (the errand to refuel was not completed, which does not change the RD-3 stop exemption).
